name: Repo Cartographer
when: An unfamiliar or inherited repo must be understood before a change: 'what does this repo do', 'where is X', 'adopt this project'.
what_it_adds: Returns a one-page map (entry points, real build/test commands run once to confirm, conventions, hot files) with file:line pointers instead of prose, so the lead never re-reads the tree.

name: Docs Snapshotter
when: Code will use a library, API or platform feature whose current version matters: 'use the latest', 'new API', 'breaking change', 'Vercel/Vite/Supabase docs'.
what_it_adds: Fetches the official docs for the pinned version and returns only the exact signatures, limits and gotchas with URLs and retrieval date, forbidding answers from memory.

name: API Live Prober
when: A third-party service is a candidate source: 'does this API have a free tier', 'quota', 'rate limit', 'terms', 'can we get data from X'.
what_it_adds: Makes one real minimal call per candidate, records status, quota headers, licence and terms, and returns a go/no-go table with the exact failure shape so builders can code the fallback.

name: Option Comparer
when: A choice between tools, libraries, vendors or approaches: 'compare', 'which is better', 'pros and cons', 'pricing', 'should we use'.
what_it_adds: Fixes weighted criteria before looking at options, re-checks prices and versions from current sources, scores each cell with a citation, and ends with a recommendation plus the condition that would flip it.

name: Deep Researcher
when: A question needs a sourced answer: 'go deep', 'research', 'what is the evidence', 'find out everything about'.
what_it_adds: Runs a breadth-first search with source tiers (primary, secondary, opinion), keeps a claim table of claim, source, date, confidence, separates fact from estimate, and logs what could not be reached.

name: Competitor Teardown
when: Existing products must be studied before building: 'similar apps', 'what do others do', 'competitors', 'inspiration', 'reviews complain about'.
what_it_adds: Builds a feature matrix from the products themselves and mines recent user complaints (store reviews, forums) into ranked recurring problems, each with a quoted source.

name: History Digger
when: The owner refers to earlier work: 'like last time', 'what did we do before', 'that app from before', 'previous chats'.
what_it_adds: Searches lessons, session titles, repo history and project state with a bounded query plan and returns dated hits with paths, saying plainly when nothing exists rather than guessing.

name: Claude Product Answerer
when: A question is about Claude, Claude Code, models, limits, pricing, skills, hooks, MCP or settings: 'can Claude', 'does Claude Code support', 'which model', 'how much does it cost'.
what_it_adds: Answers only from current official documentation and release notes fetched now (docs, anthropic.com/engineering), cites the page, and flags features that changed or are unverifiable.

name: Dataset Source Finder
when: Analysis or an app needs data that does not yet exist locally: 'find data on', 'open dataset', 'where can I get', 'public API for'.
what_it_adds: Ranks candidate sources by coverage, freshness, licence, access method and size, downloads a sample row set from the best two, and reports field meanings and known quality problems.

name: Source Harvester
when: Many pages, PDFs or files must be fetched and condensed for later use: 'collect these links', 'read all of these', 'extract from the PDFs'.
what_it_adds: Fetches in bulk on the cheapest model and writes each source to a note file with url, date and verbatim key passages, so later agents read notes and not the raw pages.

name: Requirements Extractor
when: A long or dictated request arrives: 'new project', 'I want', a pasted brief, a wall of text with many asks.
what_it_adds: Splits the request sentence by sentence into ledger lines tagged requirement, constraint, preference, ambiguity or impossible, quotes the owner's words for each, and reads dictation for intent.

name: Acceptance Test Designer
when: Requirements need a definition of done: 'done means', 'how will we know', 'acceptance criteria', 'prove it works'.
what_it_adds: Turns each requirement into one observable check with its proof artefact (command output, screenshot, word-count table) and marks which checks a script can run and which need a human.

name: Ambiguity Resolver
when: The request can be read two ways or a decision is missing: 'either', 'not sure', 'maybe', or an item only the owner can decide.
what_it_adds: Picks a default for every ambiguity and records it, keeps only questions that would change what is built (max three, each with its default), and writes the rest as click-only owner items.

name: Architecture Decider
when: A structural choice will be costly to change: 'architecture', 'which stack', 'database', 'how should this be structured', 'ADR'.
what_it_adds: Writes a decision record with at least two real alternatives, reversibility rating, failure modes and the single measurement that would prove it wrong; flags one-way doors for owner approval.

name: Ticket Slicer
when: A project or programme must be split into work units: 'break down', 'plan the build', 'phases', 'in parallel', 'tickets'.
what_it_adds: Slices by file ownership so no two helpers touch the same file, marks which slices are truly independent (parallel) and which are sequential, caps fan-out at four, and attaches a check to each.

name: Rubric Mapper
when: A list of required deliverables or a grading rubric is pasted: 'make sure we have all of this', 'rubric', 'course requirements', 'checklist of deliverables'.
what_it_adds: Maps each rubric line to a file or section and returns a present/missing/wrong table with evidence, stating in the first sentence if the repo is empty.

name: Blueprint Extractor
when: A finished thing should become a reusable pattern: 'make a blueprint', 'template so another topic works', 'same kind of app'.
what_it_adds: Separates what is constant from what is topic-specific, parameterises the latter in one config, and proves the blueprint by generating a second small instance that builds.

name: Migration Planner
when: Moving or rewriting a working system: 'migrate', 'port to', 'replace X with Y', 'upgrade the whole', 'move hosting'.
what_it_adds: Produces a step order with a rollback for every step, a parity checklist of old behaviour, and a dry-run stage, refusing any plan with an irreversible step lacking a backup.

name: Backlog Prioritiser
when: Many ideas compete for limited effort: 'what first', 'prioritise', 'roadmap', 'too many ideas', 'what matters most'.
what_it_adds: Scores items on stated value, cost in tokens and dependency, shows the ranking formula, and cuts to a short ordered list with a defer reason for the rest.

name: Feasibility Reframer
when: A request may be impossible or need a service, device or account the session lacks: 'can you transfer to Xbox', 'on my phone', 'train a model', 'quantum', 'automatically log in'.
what_it_adds: Checks the real path before any build, names which steps need a PC, paid service or the owner, and reframes impossible asks into the closest measurable thing, in a short feasibility note.

name: Web App Scaffolder
when: A new web or phone app starts: 'build a web app', 'Vite', 'React', 'deploy on Vercel', 'new project'.
what_it_adds: Creates a minimal buildable app with project commands, a version string shown in the UI, a green first gate and a Vercel-ready config before any feature work, so deployment is proven on day one.

name: Phone First UI Builder
when: Screens are built for an iPhone user: 'iPhone', 'phone', 'mobile first', 'safe area', 'PWA', 'tap target'.
what_it_adds: Builds at 390 px width first with safe-area insets, 100dvh handling, 44 px targets and iOS Safari input quirks, and captures phone-size screenshots as proof.

name: PWA Offline Engineer
when: An app must install on the home screen or work offline: 'install', 'offline', 'service worker', 'manifest', 'works without signal'.
what_it_adds: Implements manifest, service worker versioning and cache invalidation, tests offline and update flows, and handles iOS storage eviction and stale-version traps that stop users seeing new deploys.

name: API Integration Builder
when: The app calls an outside service: 'integrate', 'API key', 'PlantNet', 'quota', 'fallback source', 'webhook'.
what_it_adds: Puts the service behind an interface with caching, retry with backoff, a switch to a second source on quota errors, recorded fixtures and a simulated quota-error test; keys come from environment only.

name: Game Builder
when: A game or playful interactive build is requested: 'game', 'level', 'keep improving it', 'score', 'play on my phone'.
what_it_adds: Ships in small playable waves with a deterministic game-loop test, touch controls checked at phone size, and a one-paragraph wave note, so each wave is playable before the next starts.

name: Learning App Builder
when: A book, course or topic becomes an app: 'learn from this book', 'quiz', 'flashcards', 'lessons', 'study app'.
what_it_adds: Defines a lesson/question schema tied to source passages, spaced-repetition scheduling and answer checking against the source, and keeps content in data files so another topic reuses the engine.

name: CLI Script Builder
when: A small tool or automation script is needed: 'script that', 'tool to', 'command', 'stdlib only', 'batch process'.
what_it_adds: Writes dependency-free, idempotent scripts with a self-test, a dry-run flag and short output, writes large outputs in parts, and never inlines binaries.

name: Content Site Builder
when: Many documents become a website or wiki: 'wiki', 'docs site', 'publish these pages', 'static site from markdown'.
what_it_adds: Generates pages from source files with link, heading and image checks at build time, a search index, and a sitemap, so content edits never need hand-edited HTML.

name: Minecraft Structure Builder
when: Structures or worlds for Minecraft are requested: 'Minecraft', 'Xbox world', 'build a castle in', 'schematic', 'mcstructure'.
what_it_adds: Confirms the edition and transfer path first (what needs a PC, a realm or a paid tool), then generates structure files in the right format with a size and block-palette check and a preview render.

name: Refactor Engineer
when: Behaviour must stay the same while code changes: 'refactor', 'clean up', 'rename across', 'split this file', 'reduce duplication'.
what_it_adds: Writes characterisation tests first, changes in small steps each ending green, forbids behaviour edits in the same commit, and reports a before and after diff of public surface.

name: Build Failure Diagnoser
when: A build, test or CI run fails: 'build failed', 'red', 'error in the log', 'Vercel build error', pasted stack trace.
what_it_adds: Reads the saved full log (not the console), finds the first real failing step, quotes the error line, separates root cause from cascade, and proposes the smallest fix before editing.

name: Deploy Doctor
when: The live site is wrong or old: '404', 'still showing the old version', 'not deploying', 'Vercel', 'environment variable'.
what_it_adds: Compares served version string, latest commit, build settings, root directory and env vars in a fixed order, makes a bounded number of checks, and tells the owner in the first line what is wrong plus click-only steps.

name: Release To Main Engineer
when: Finished work must go live from main: 'deploy', 'release', 'push to main', 'ship it'.
what_it_adds: Runs the full gate, stores its output, fast-forwards main only on green, never force-pushes, tags, and confirms the live address serves the new version within a bounded wait.

name: Rollback Restorer
when: The owner wants an earlier state back: 'go back', 'revert everything', 'worst it has been', 'undo', 'cancel'.
what_it_adds: Finds the last tagged good state, restores by new commits (no history rewrite), and proves the result with an empty diff against that state and a list of what was undone.

name: E2E Test Author
when: Behaviour needs browser-level proof: 'end to end', 'Playwright', 'test on iPhone size', 'screenshot test', 'regression'.
what_it_adds: Writes stable tests with phone viewports and role-based selectors, no sleeps, saves screenshots as evidence, and refuses to skip or loosen a failing test to get green.

name: Coverage Analyst
when: Test health is questioned: 'test coverage', 'what is untested', 'improve the tests', 'audit the tests'.
what_it_adds: Measures real coverage with the project's tool, ranks uncovered code by risk (not by size), and proposes tests in that order with the number each would add.

name: Performance Profiler
when: Something is slow or a budget is set: 'slow', 'Lighthouse', 'bundle size', 'LCP', 'laggy on phone'.
what_it_adds: Measures against stated budgets with phone-class throttling, repeats on a quiet machine before declaring red, and ties every fix to a before and after number.

name: Accessibility Auditor
when: A UI must be usable by everyone: 'accessibility', 'screen reader', 'contrast', 'WCAG', 'keyboard', 'Dynamic Type'.
what_it_adds: Checks against WCAG 2.2 AA with automated scan plus manual keyboard and label walk-through, returns severity-ranked findings with element and fix, and does not edit.

name: Dependency Upgrader
when: Packages are outdated or flagged: 'upgrade', 'outdated', 'vulnerability', 'npm audit', 'major version'.
what_it_adds: Upgrades one major at a time after reading its changelog, runs the gate after each, and reverts the single step that breaks instead of unpicking a batch.

name: Bug Reproducer
when: A bug is reported vaguely: 'it is broken', 'doesn't work on my phone', 'sometimes', 'weird behaviour'.
what_it_adds: Reduces the report to a minimal reproduction and a failing test before touching code, states the environment it fails in, and confirms the fix turns that test green.

name: Data Pipeline Builder
when: Data must be collected and transformed repeatedly: 'pipeline', 'harvest', 'ETL', 'scrape', 'ingest every day'.
what_it_adds: Builds stages that are safe to re-run, cache raw responses, respect rate limits and robots rules, log row counts per stage, and reconcile totals so a clean re-run gives identical output.

name: Exploratory Analyst
when: A dataset must be understood: 'analyse this data', 'what is in this CSV', 'patterns', 'summarise the numbers'.
what_it_adds: Profiles types, units, missingness, duplicates and outliers before any conclusion, ships the script that reproduces each number, and labels findings as observed versus inferred.

name: Statistical Tester
when: A claim of difference or relationship needs support: 'is it significant', 'compare groups', 'correlation', 'A/B', 'experiment'.
what_it_adds: Picks the test from the data's design, checks assumptions, reports effect size with interval (not only p), corrects for multiple comparisons, and states what the data cannot show.

name: Chart Maker
when: Numbers need a figure: 'chart', 'graph', 'plot', 'visualise', 'dashboard'.
what_it_adds: Chooses chart type from the question, starts axes honestly, labels units, uses colour-blind-safe palettes, and checks legibility at phone width.

name: Spreadsheet Engineer
when: An Excel or Sheets deliverable is requested: 'spreadsheet', 'xlsx', 'budget sheet', 'tracker', 'formulas'.
what_it_adds: Uses live formulas not pasted values, separates inputs from calculations, adds check cells that must equal zero, and recalculates and scans for errors before delivery.

name: Data Reconciler
when: Sources disagree or must be joined: 'merge these', 'dedupe', 'numbers don't match', 'reconcile', 'combine datasets'.
what_it_adds: Defines join keys and tolerance up front, reports unmatched rows on both sides, and shows that totals before and after the join add up.

name: Schema Migration Engineer
when: Stored data shape changes: 'migrate the database', 'change the schema', 'rename the field', 'old exports must still open'.
what_it_adds: Writes additive-by-default migrations that are safe to run twice, takes a backup before any destructive step, and tests against fixtures of every earlier version.

name: Biodiversity Data Integrator
when: Species, plants or bird observations are involved: 'PlantNet', 'GBIF', 'eBird', 'species identification', 'taxonomy'.
what_it_adds: Resolves names through a taxonomic backbone, keeps coordinate uncertainty and record basis, validates an identification against occurrence data, and handles each service's quota and licence.

name: ML Experiment Runner
when: A model is trained or compared: 'train', 'classifier', 'predict', 'fine-tune', 'accuracy', 'benchmark the models'.
what_it_adds: Fixes the split before modelling to prevent leakage, runs a trivial baseline first, sets seeds, logs configuration with each metric, and reports against the baseline only.

name: RAG Index Builder
when: Documents must be searchable by an AI: 'knowledge base', 'search my files', 'retrieval', 'embeddings', 'any AI can use'.
what_it_adds: Chunks along document structure, builds keyword plus vector search, writes a golden question set first and gates on recall at k, and returns small exact chunks with parent pointers.

name: Long Form Drafter
when: A long document is requested: 'book', 'long report', 'detailed guide', '5,000 words', 'chapters'.
what_it_adds: Outlines with a word budget per section, writes in chunks that cannot time out, keeps a running summary and term list for consistency, and verifies counts with a script.

name: Batch Article Rewriter
when: Many pieces need the same transformation: 'rewrite 60 articles', 'expand each to 800 words', 'all pages'.
what_it_adds: Plans batches within the output limit, applies one style sheet to all, checks each item's word count and facts against its source, and reports a per-item table of pass or retry.

name: Knowledge Base Compiler
when: Raw material becomes structured reference: 'brochure from this conversation', 'turn this into a knowledge base', 'organise my notes'.
what_it_adds: Extracts atomic facts into topic files each with source and confidence, lists assumptions separately, builds an index file, and tests retrieval with sample questions.

name: Canonical Facts Keeper
when: Dates, names, figures or personal facts must stay exactly right across documents: 'be accurate about my dates', 'facts', 'itinerary', 'consistent'.
what_it_adds: Maintains one facts file with source for each entry and diffs every derived document against it, reporting each mismatch with location until none remain.

name: Document Producer
when: A downloadable document is the output: 'PDF', 'Word doc', 'docx', 'brochure', 'report to download'.
what_it_adds: Builds from structured source with styles, renders pages to images and inspects them for overflow, orphaned headings and missing fonts before delivery.

name: Deck Builder
when: A presentation is requested: 'slides', 'deck', 'PowerPoint', 'pptx', 'present this'.
what_it_adds: Writes one claim per slide as the title, limits text per slide, renders every slide to an image for overflow checks, and keeps speaker notes with sources.

name: Strategy Memo Writer
when: A decision or plan must be argued: 'strategy', 'proposal', 'business plan', 'recommendation', 'memo'.
what_it_adds: Opens with the recommendation, states trade-offs and what would change the answer, labels estimates, and cites every figure, so the owner can decide from the first page.

name: Legal Research Analyst
when: A legal question or case analysis, especially Spanish law: 'ley', 'derecho', 'BOE', 'jurisprudencia', 'is it legal', 'my rights', 'contract clause'.
what_it_adds: Identifies jurisdiction and the date law applied, cites primary sources (statute article, court decision) with links, separates fact, interpretation and estimate, and states limits including that it is not legal advice.

name: Case Chronology Builder
when: Documents or messages must become a timeline: 'timeline of events', 'chronology', 'what happened when', 'case file'.
what_it_adds: Extracts dated events with a pinpoint source for each, flags conflicts and gaps between documents, and never fills a gap with an inference unlabelled.

name: Agent Spec Writer
when: Agent, skill or workflow files are to be written: 'team of agents', 'sub-agent', 'skill file', 'workflow', 'CLAUDE.md', exact word counts.
what_it_adds: Writes each spec to current Anthropic guidance (clear goal, constraints, check, return format, minimal tools), hits stated word counts, and registers files in the right folder.

name: Spanish English Translator
when: Text moves between Spanish and English: 'translate', 'traduce', 'in Spanish', 'in English', 'bilingual edition'.
what_it_adds: Translates for meaning and register not word order, keeps a glossary and protects names, numbers and code, and flags untranslatable idioms with the choice made.

name: Spanish Original Writer
when: New content is written directly in Spanish: 'escribe', 'en español', 'redacta', Spanish-speaking audience.
what_it_adds: Decides Spain or Latin-American variant, tu or usted, and punctuation conventions up front, and writes natively rather than from English structure.

name: Copy Editor
when: Existing text needs polishing without changing meaning: 'proofread', 'edit', 'tighten', 'fix grammar', 'make it clearer'.
what_it_adds: Edits in three passes (meaning, flow, mechanics), preserves the author's voice, and returns tracked changes with reasons so each edit can be refused.

name: Glossary Builder
when: Terms must be consistent across documents or languages: 'terminology', 'glossary', 'technical terms', 'same word everywhere'.
what_it_adds: Extracts candidate terms by frequency, sets the approved rendering in each language with a source, and ships a check that flags deviations.

name: Back Translation Checker
when: A translation must be verified: 'check the translation', 'does it say the same', 'blind check'.
what_it_adds: Translates a sample back without seeing the source, compares meaning point by point, and lists divergences by severity (meaning, tone, omission).

name: UI String Localiser
when: An app interface must support languages: 'i18n', 'language switch', 'string table', 'translate the UI'.
what_it_adds: Extracts strings to keys with plural and gender forms, checks text-expansion overflow at phone width, and tests that no key is missing in any locale.

name: Bilingual Site Publisher
when: One site ships in two languages: 'English and Spanish versions', 'language toggle', 'hreflang', 'both editions'.
what_it_adds: Sets locale routing and language tags, keeps both editions at parity with a diff of missing pages, and remembers the visitor's choice.

name: Legal Terms Translator
when: Legal text crosses Spanish and English: 'contrato', 'sentencia', 'translate this legal', 'legal terms'.
what_it_adds: Renders terms of art with a note where legal systems have no equivalent, keeps the original term in brackets, and refuses to smooth over a clause's ambiguity.

name: Voice Matcher
when: Writing must sound like a specific person or style: 'in my voice', 'like this author', 'same tone as', 'travel journal voice'.
what_it_adds: Derives a short style sheet from real samples (sentence length, diction, devices, forbidden habits), writes against it, and self-scores a blind sample against the originals.

name: Transcript Cleaner
when: Dictated or transcribed text must become clean prose: 'dictated', 'voice note', 'transcript', 'clean this up'.
what_it_adds: Reads for intent not spelling, removes fillers and repairs mis-hearings using context, keeps every fact verbatim, and flags uncertain words instead of guessing.

name: Design Brief Author
when: A redesign or new look starts: 'redesign', 'make it look better', 'more premium', 'book-centric', 'design brief'.
what_it_adds: Writes a one-page brief with named references, tokens (type, colour, spacing), constraints and a scoring rubric, so builders and critics work from the same target.

name: Visual Option Generator
when: Taste decides and the owner will choose: 'propose 5 icons', 'palette options', 'logo ideas', 'I will choose'.
what_it_adds: Renders distinct options as images with a one-line rationale each in a numbered menu, then applies the chosen one everywhere and lists replaced assets.

name: Visual Polish Measurer
when: A precise visual correction is requested: 'exactly centred', 'make it larger', 'misaligned', 'pixel', 'spacing off'.
what_it_adds: Measures element positions from the rendered page or screenshot before and after, reports the offset in pixels, and iterates until within tolerance.

name: Design Critic
when: A UI needs an independent quality score: 'review the design', 'does it look good', 'critic', before shipping a visual change.
what_it_adds: Scores screenshots blind to the author against a fixed rubric out of 10 with must-fix items and a verdict, and never sees the builder's reasoning.

name: Design System Builder
when: Visual consistency must be enforced in code: 'design system', 'tokens', 'component library', 'consistent styles'.
what_it_adds: Defines tokens and primitives and adds a lint rule that fails on hard-coded colour or spacing, so style drift is caught by a check, not by review.

name: Image Pipeline Engineer
when: Photos or images are stored and shown: 'hero photos', 'upload', 'thumbnails', 'rotate', 'HEIC', 'EXIF', 'image size'.
what_it_adds: Keeps originals untouched, generates sized derivatives, handles EXIF orientation and format conversion, and tests rotation and file sizes.

name: Motion Builder
when: Animation or transitions are needed: 'animation', 'transition', 'recreate this effect', 'micro-interaction', 'smooth'.
what_it_adds: Specifies duration and easing from measured reference, animates only compositor properties, honours reduced-motion, and checks frame time on a throttled phone profile.

name: Audio Lesson Producer
when: Text becomes speech or audio: 'audio for the lesson', 'text to speech', 'voice', 'narration', 'podcast'.
what_it_adds: Rewrites text for the ear (short sentences, spelled-out numbers), produces one sample file first and waits for the owner's yes before the full run, and estimates cost beforehand.

name: Diagram Maker
when: Structure must be shown visually: 'diagram', 'flowchart', 'architecture picture', 'map of the system'.
what_it_adds: Builds from text source (Mermaid or SVG), limits nodes so it reads at phone width, renders to an image and inspects it before delivery.

name: Name And Copy Options
when: Names, taglines or short copy are needed: 'name for', 'tagline', 'button text', 'title ideas', 'what should we call'.
what_it_adds: Produces five deliberately different options with a one-line rationale and a quick availability or ambiguity check, as a numbered menu for the owner.

name: Requirement Verifier
when: Work is claimed complete: 'is it done', 'verify everything', 'check against the request', before the final report.
what_it_adds: Re-reads the original request, checks each ledger line against fresh evidence the verifier produces itself, and returns met, missing or wrong per line with the evidence.

name: Fact Checker
when: Claims, numbers or dates in a document must be true: 'fact check', 'verify the figures', 'sources for this'.
what_it_adds: Extracts every checkable claim, traces each to a primary source, grades it supported, unsupported or contradicted, and flags the claims that were silently estimates.

name: Code Reviewer
when: A change is ready to merge: 'review this', 'PR review', 'look over my diff', a non-trivial diff.
what_it_adds: Reviews the diff against stated intent for correctness, edge cases, missing tests and scope creep, and ranks findings with a file:line and a concrete fix, without style nitpicks.

name: Security Reviewer
when: Code touches auth, sharing links, uploads, secrets, payments or user data: 'security', 'login', 'public link', 'exposed'.
what_it_adds: Models the threats for this app's trust boundaries, tests the top three paths concretely, and reports severity-ranked findings with exploit sketch and fix.

name: Secret Scanner
when: Keys, tokens or passwords may be in files, history or a reply: 'API key', 'token', 'pasted a key', before any commit or push.
what_it_adds: Scans working tree, history and the draft reply for key patterns, reports location without repeating the secret, and gives the rotate-and-store-in-settings steps.

name: Premortem Red Team
when: A decision is hard to reverse or the stakes are high: 'before we commit', 'delete', 'publish', 'migrate production', 'what could go wrong'.
what_it_adds: Assumes the plan failed and writes the three most likely causes with the earliest detectable signal and a cheap test for each, then argues the best case against proceeding.

name: Injection Auditor
when: An agent or app reads untrusted text or has powerful tools: 'web content into the prompt', 'MCP', 'tool permissions', 'agent that browses'.
what_it_adds: Traces where untrusted text reaches instructions or tools, attempts concrete injections, and recommends permission narrowing and data/instruction separation.

name: Legal Citation Verifier
when: A legal text cites laws or cases: 'check these citations', before delivering any legal analysis.
what_it_adds: Opens every cited provision or decision, confirms it exists, is in force at the relevant date, and says what is claimed, and marks any citation it could not open.

name: Privacy Licence Reviewer
when: Personal data, location, photos, fonts, datasets or dependencies are published or shared: 'GDPR', 'licence', 'can we use this', 'geotag'.
what_it_adds: Inventories personal data and third-party assets, checks each licence against the intended use, and lists required attributions and redactions.

name: Clean Clone Verifier
when: Instructions or builds must work on a fresh machine: 'does it work from scratch', 'install steps', 'clean checkout', before giving the owner steps.
what_it_adds: Follows the written steps literally in a fresh clone with no prior state and reports the first step that fails with the exact output.

name: Session Handover Writer
when: A session ends, context is near its limit, or work continues elsewhere: 'handover', 'new chat', 'continue later', 'get everything ready to continue'.
what_it_adds: Writes state from facts (running tasks, tree status, next ticket) into the single state file and returns a one-line paste prompt, after confirming both repos are clean and pushed.

name: Needs You Composer
when: Something only the owner can do blocks one part of the work: account, key, payment, taste decision.
what_it_adds: Writes a numbered item with what, why, exact click steps for a phone, and what was done meanwhile, so the rest of the work continues.

name: Owner Computer Guide
when: The owner must run something on his own machine: 'how do I run this on my Mac', 'Windows error', 'terminal', 'close everything'.
what_it_adds: Prefers a browser route, otherwise one copy-and-paste box per step with the expected output, explains a pasted error in one sentence, and gives the single stop command.

name: Git Repo Operator
when: Repository housekeeping: 'merge', 'conflict', 'branch', 'clean the repo', 'move files', 'which chat is on this'.
what_it_adds: Inspects state first, uses non-destructive commands only, never force-pushes or deletes unmerged work, and ends with a clean-tree and branch-position report.

name: Routine Builder
when: Something must run on a schedule or automatically: 'every morning', 'cron', 'routine', 'automate', 'remind me'.
what_it_adds: Builds the job idempotent with a dry run, a failure notice that reaches the owner, a cost estimate per run, and a one-page stop guide.

name: Setup Repairer
when: The Claude working setup misbehaves: 'hook not firing', 'skill not loading', 'settings', 'MCP not connecting', 'permission denied'.
what_it_adds: Reproduces the symptom, checks settings, hook, skill and agent files against current documentation in a fixed order, and fixes the smallest layer with a test that the symptom is gone.

name: Token Cost Auditor
when: Cost or efficiency is questioned: 'too expensive', 'token use', 'make it cheaper', 'why so many tokens', after a large run.
what_it_adds: Reads real per-helper usage from the ledger, compares with the budget set, names the top three waste sources (re-reading, over-fan-out, wrong tier) and the measured saving of each.

name: Eval Regression Runner
when: The brain's own method, routing or templates change: 'did it get worse', 'regression', 'evaluate the change', before a learning update is accepted.
what_it_adds: Runs the fixed eval set before and after a change, compares scores and cost per task class, and blocks acceptance if any earlier capability drops.

name: Lesson Distiller
when: A project or hard ticket finishes: 'what did we learn', 'lessons', 'post-mortem', at close.
what_it_adds: Extracts only lessons backed by an observed event (failure, cost, fix), writes each as a rule with trigger and evidence, drops generic advice, and keeps project-specific items out of the brain.

name: Project Bootstrapper
when: A repo is paired with the brain for the first time or must be made compatible: 'set up', 'adopt', 'new project', 'initialise'.
what_it_adds: Creates or validates the project contract file, state file and extension folder, places project-specific tools in the project repo, and runs validation so the pairing works from the next session.
